title: Slipway deprecations
description: schema/deprecations.json: every renamed config key and front-matter field that still works and warns (ADR 0012, rule 4). tools/theme/deprecations.mjs reads it to warn, and _includes/compat.html reads the old name when the new one is unset.

deprecations.description: One entry per renamed key, oldest first.

kind.description: config: a key in _config.yml, as a dotted path from the root (slipway.tokens.radius). front-matter: a field in a page's front matter or in a `defaults` entry's `values`.

new.description: The name that replaces it. It wins when both are set.

since.description: The release that deprecated the old name.

removed_in.description: The first release that may remove the old name: the next major (the next 0.MINOR before 1.0).
